homeFaqs.q: Are my images uploaded to your servers?

homeFaqs.q: Do I need to create an account?
homeFaqs.a: No. Piclizer requires no registration, no email and no personal information. Open a tool and start working immediately.

homeFaqs.q: Does it work on mobile phones?
homeFaqs.a: Yes. Piclizer works in any modern browser on Android, iPhone, tablets and desktop computers. Some heavy operations are faster on a desktop, but everything works on mobile.
JPG, PNG and WebP are supported across the platform, plus GIF for resizing. Each tool lists its exact supported formats on its page.
Completely. Since processing happens on your device, there is nothing for us to collect, store or share. We don't use your images for anything.

homeFaqs.q: Why is it faster than other tools?
homeFaqs.a: There is no upload or download time. Processing starts instantly and uses your device's own computing power.

categoryIntros.compress: Large images slow down websites, apps and emails. Our compressor tools shrink JPG, PNG and WebP files by intelligently reducing quality and metadata — all in your browser, with no quality loss you can see.
categoryIntros.resize: Need exact dimensions for a profile picture, a website banner or a print job? Resize images to precise pixel sizes, keep the aspect ratio, and export in the same format.
categoryIntros.convert: Different situations need different formats. Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP in seconds — with quality control, transparency handling and background color options.
categoryIntros.edit: From simple flips and rotations to cropping, merging and watermarking — edit your images exactly how you need, without installing any software.
categoryIntros.pdf: Turn single images or entire galleries into clean PDF documents. Choose page sizes, orientations and order — generated entirely on your device.
categoryIntros.color: Extract the exact colors from any image. Pick a pixel's HEX, RGB and HSL values, or generate a complete color palette from a photo.

categoryIntros.calculator-tools: Quick, reliable answers for the numbers that come up in daily life — your age, your BMI, a discount at the till, interest on savings, a tip to split or a unit you need converted. Every calculator shows the formula and the steps behind its result.
categoryIntros.developer-tools: The small utilities every developer needs, gathered in one fast, private place. Format JSON, test a regular expression, generate a UUID, hash a file or convert a colour — with no sign-up, no rate limits and no code ever leaving your browser.

image-compressor.name: Image Compressor
image-compressor.short: Reduce image file size while keeping quality.
image-compressor.description: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images online for free. Reduce file size in your browser with a quality slider — no upload, no watermark.
image-compressor.intro: Shrink your images to a fraction of their size without any visible quality loss. Perfect for websites, emails and apps where every kilobyte matters. Adjust the quality slider and watch the size savings in real time.
howTo: Add one or more images using drag & drop or the browse button.
Choose the output quality with the slider (lower = smaller file).
Optionally pick a different output format.
Press Compress and download your optimized images.

faqs.a: Piclizer redraws your image using your browser's built-in encoder with a quality setting you control. Lower quality means a smaller file. Processing happens entirely on your device.
At 70–90% quality, most photos look nearly identical to the original while being significantly smaller. You can preview the result before downloading.
JPG, PNG and WebP. You can keep the original format or export to a different one.

faqs.q: Can I compress multiple images at once?
faqs.a: Yes — add as many files as you like and they will be processed in a batch, one after another.
No. Compression uses your browser's Canvas API. Your images never leave your device.

image-resizer.name: Image Resizer
image-resizer.description: Resize JPG, PNG, WebP and GIF images online to exact pixel dimensions. Preset or custom sizes, aspect-ratio lock, 100% in your browser.
image-resizer.intro: Get your images to the exact pixel size you need. Choose a preset or enter custom width and height, lock the aspect ratio, and export at the same quality as the original.
howTo: Add an image to resize.
Choose a preset size or enter custom dimensions.
Keep the aspect-ratio lock on to avoid distortion, or unlock it for exact values.
Press Resize and download your image.

faqs.a: Downscaling an image keeps it sharp; upscaling beyond the original size cannot add detail and may look softer. Piclizer resamples smoothly using your browser's graphics engine.
When locked, changing the width automatically adjusts the height to keep the image proportions, preventing stretching.
JPG, PNG, WebP and GIF. The output keeps the original format.
Yes, transparency is preserved when the output stays PNG.

image-cropper.name: Image Cropper
image-cropper.short: Crop images interactively with ratio presets.
image-cropper.description: Crop JPG, PNG and WebP images online for free. Drag to select, choose aspect ratios like 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 — all in your browser.
image-cropper.intro: Cut away the parts you don't need with an interactive crop tool. Drag the selection box, snap to common aspect ratios, and export the exact region you want.
howTo: Add an image to crop.
Drag the corners of the crop box to select the area.
Pick an aspect ratio preset, or keep it free-form.
Press Crop and download the result.

faqs.q: Can I crop to an exact aspect ratio?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose from Free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:2 and 9:16 presets.
You see the crop dimensions live as you drag, and the final image is rendered at full original resolution.
No — the crop is exported at the original quality in the same format.

image-rotator.name: Image Rotator
image-rotator.short: Rotate images by 90°, 180° or any angle.
image-rotator.description: Rotate JPG, PNG and WebP images online. Quick 90°, 180° and custom-angle rotation with live preview — free and private.
image-rotator.intro: Fix sideways photos or get creative with custom angles. Use the quick buttons for 90° and 180° turns, or enter any angle from 0 to 360 degrees.
howTo: Add an image to rotate.
Use the quick buttons or enter a custom angle.
Preview the rotation live.
Press Rotate and download the result.

faqs.q: Can I rotate by any angle?
faqs.a: Yes, any value between 0 and 360 degrees, plus the 90° and 180° shortcuts.
For PNG images, newly exposed corners stay transparent. For JPG they are filled with white.
90° and 180° rotations are lossless. Arbitrary angles re-render the image, which can cause a slight resample.

flip-image-horizontal.name: Flip Image Horizontally
flip-image-horizontal.description: Flip JPG, PNG and WebP images horizontally online. Create a perfect mirror image in one click, free and 100% in your browser.
flip-image-horizontal.intro: Create a mirror image instantly. A horizontal flip swaps left and right — useful for fixing selfies, product shots and creative compositions.
howTo: Add an image to flip.
Press Flip horizontally.
Preview the mirror image.
Download your flipped image.

faqs.a: The image is mirrored along the vertical axis — the left side becomes the right side, like looking in a mirror.
No. Flipping is a pixel-perfect transform with no quality loss.
JPG, PNG and WebP, with the output in the same format.

flip-image-vertical.name: Flip Image Vertically
flip-image-vertical.description: Flip JPG, PNG and WebP images vertically online. Mirror an image upside-down in one click, free and private.
flip-image-vertical.intro: Turn an image upside down instantly. A vertical flip mirrors the image along the horizontal axis — top becomes bottom.
howTo: Add an image to flip.
Press Flip vertically.
Preview the result.
Download your flipped image.

faqs.a: The image is mirrored along the horizontal axis, so the top and bottom are swapped.
No. Flipping is a pixel-perfect transform with no quality loss.
JPG, PNG and WebP, with the output in the same format.

jpg-to-png.name: JPG to PNG
jpg-to-png.short: Convert JPG images to PNG format.
jpg-to-png.description: Convert JPG to PNG online for free. Turn JPEG images into high-quality PNG files right in your browser, no upload needed.
jpg-to-png.intro: Convert your JPG photos to the lossless PNG format. PNG is ideal when you need crisp text, graphics or a format that supports transparency for future edits.
howTo: Add a JPG image.
Press Convert to PNG.
Compare the file sizes.
Download your new PNG.

faqs.q: Why is the PNG larger than my JPG?
faqs.a: PNG is a lossless format, so it keeps every pixel without compression artifacts — which usually means a bigger file than a lossy JPG.

faqs.q: Does JPG to PNG improve quality?
faqs.a: It prevents further loss when you re-save, but it can't restore detail that JPG compression already removed.
No — conversion runs entirely in your browser.

png-to-jpg.name: PNG to JPG
png-to-jpg.short: Convert PNG images to JPG format.
png-to-jpg.description: Convert PNG to JPG online for free. Choose a background color for transparency and a quality level — all in your browser.
png-to-jpg.intro: Turn PNG images into smaller JPG files. Since JPG doesn't support transparency, you can choose the background color that replaces transparent areas.
howTo: Add a PNG image.
Pick a background color for transparent areas.
Set the output quality.
Press Convert and download your JPG.

faqs.a: JPG has no transparency, so transparent pixels are filled with your chosen background color (white by default).
Usually yes — JPG compresses photos much more efficiently than PNG, especially for photographic images.
Yes, with the quality slider. 80–90% is a good balance for most photos.

jpg-to-webp.name: JPG to WebP
jpg-to-webp.short: Convert JPG images to modern WebP format.
jpg-to-webp.description: Convert JPG to WebP online for free. Smaller files with equal quality, converted entirely in your browser.
jpg-to-webp.intro: WebP is the modern web format that delivers the same visual quality as JPG at a much smaller file size. Convert your photos and speed up your website instantly.
howTo: Add a JPG image.
Set the output quality.
Press Convert to WebP.
Download your optimized WebP file.

faqs.a: WebP is a modern image format from Google that produces smaller files than JPG at the same visual quality. All major browsers support it.

faqs.q: How much smaller will my file be?
faqs.a: Typically 25–35% smaller than an equivalent JPG, depending on the image content.

faqs.q: What if my browser can't encode WebP?
faqs.a: Piclizer detects this and shows a clear message suggesting an up-to-date browser such as Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

png-to-webp.name: PNG to WebP
png-to-webp.short: Convert PNG images to WebP, keeping transparency.
png-to-webp.description: Convert PNG to WebP online for free with full transparency support. Smaller files, same quality, all in your browser.
png-to-webp.intro: Get the benefits of WebP with the transparency of PNG. Convert logos, icons and graphics to a format that's dramatically smaller while staying crisp.
howTo: Add a PNG image.
Set the output quality.
Press Convert to WebP.
Download your transparent WebP file.

faqs.a: Yes. WebP supports full alpha transparency, and Piclizer keeps it intact.
At 90–100% quality the result is visually identical to the source for nearly all images.
Static images are fully supported. Animated images are converted as a single frame.

webp-to-jpg.name: WebP to JPG
webp-to-jpg.short: Convert WebP images to JPG format.
webp-to-jpg.description: Convert WebP to JPG online for free. Pick a background color for transparency and a quality level — entirely in your browser.
webp-to-jpg.intro: Need a WebP image in the more universally compatible JPG format? Convert it in seconds with full control over background color and quality.
howTo: Add a WebP image.
Choose a background color for transparent areas.
Set the output quality.
Press Convert and download your JPG.

faqs.a: Some older apps and devices don't open WebP. JPG works everywhere.
Transparent areas are filled with your selected background color.
JPG is a lossy format, so some data is discarded. Keep quality at 85%+ to minimize visible loss.

webp-to-png.name: WebP to PNG
webp-to-png.short: Convert WebP images to PNG format.
webp-to-png.description: Convert WebP to PNG online for free with full transparency support. Lossless-quality conversion right in your browser.
webp-to-png.intro: Convert WebP images to the lossless PNG format. Ideal when you need to edit the image further or preserve every pixel including transparency.
howTo: Add a WebP image.
Press Convert to PNG.
Compare the file sizes.
Download your PNG.

faqs.a: Yes, fully. Transparent WebP images convert to transparent PNGs.
Often yes — PNG is lossless and stores every pixel, so files are usually larger than lossy WebP.
No, the conversion happens entirely on your device.

image-to-pdf.name: Image to PDF
image-to-pdf.short: Turn a single image into a PDF document.
image-to-pdf.description: Convert JPG, PNG or WebP to PDF online for free. Choose A4 or Letter page size and orientation — generated in your browser.
image-to-pdf.intro: Turn any image into a clean, shareable PDF document. Choose A4 or Letter size, portrait or landscape, or fit the page exactly to your image.
howTo: Add an image.
Choose the page size and orientation.
Press Create PDF.
Download your PDF.

faqs.q: How is the image placed on the page?
faqs.a: With A4 or Letter, the image is centered and scaled to fit within the page margins. Fit-to-image makes the page exactly the size of your image.

faqs.q: Are my images uploaded to create the PDF?
faqs.a: No. The PDF is generated entirely in your browser using client-side libraries.
Yes, up to 50 MB per image. Larger images may need to be resized first.

images-to-pdf.name: Images to PDF
images-to-pdf.short: Combine multiple images into one PDF.
images-to-pdf.description: Combine multiple JPG, PNG or WebP images into a single PDF online. Reorder pages, choose page size — free and private.
images-to-pdf.intro: Build a multi-page PDF from a set of images. Drag thumbnails to reorder the pages, choose the page size, and generate one clean document.
howTo: Add all the images you want in the PDF.
Drag the thumbnails to set the page order.
Choose the page size.
Press Create PDF and download your document.

faqs.q: How many images can I include?
faqs.a: You can add many images at once. Each becomes one page in the PDF, in the order you arrange.
Yes — drag the thumbnails into the order you want before generating.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on file size?
faqs.a: Up to 50 MB per image. Very large sets may take a moment to generate.

merge-images.name: Merge Images
merge-images.short: Combine images side by side or stacked.
merge-images.description: Merge multiple JPG, PNG or WebP images into one image online. Horizontal or vertical, custom spacing and background — free.
merge-images.intro: Combine two or more images into a single picture. Stack them vertically or place them side by side, with control over spacing and background color.
howTo: Add two or more images.
Choose horizontal or vertical direction.
Adjust spacing and background color if needed.
Press Merge and download the combined image.

faqs.a: All images are scaled to the same dimension (the largest common size) so the merged result is perfectly aligned.
Yes — drag the thumbnails to reorder them before merging.
PNG and JPG. PNG keeps transparency; JPG uses your selected background color.

split-image.name: Split Image
split-image.short: Cut an image into a grid of tiles.
split-image.description: Split JPG, PNG or WebP images into a grid online. Choose rows and columns, then download all tiles as a ZIP — free and private.
split-image.intro: Slice an image into a grid of equal tiles — perfect for Instagram carousels, print layouts and puzzles. Set the rows and columns and download every tile in a ZIP.
howTo: Add an image to split.
Choose the number of rows and columns.
Preview the split grid.
Press Split and download all tiles as a ZIP.

faqs.q: How do I get the tiles?
faqs.a: All tiles are packaged into a single ZIP archive and downloaded together.

faqs.q: What if the image doesn't divide evenly?
faqs.a: Tiles are computed by dividing the image into equal rectangles; any remainder pixels are included in the last row/column.
JPG, PNG and WebP. Tiles keep the original format.

image-color-picker.name: Image Color Picker
image-color-picker.short: Pick exact colors from any image.
image-color-picker.description: Pick colors from any JPG, PNG or WebP image online. Get HEX, RGB and HSL values with a magnifier — free and private.
image-color-picker.intro: Click anywhere on your image to grab its exact color. Get the HEX, RGB and HSL values instantly, copy them to your clipboard, and keep a history of your recent picks.
howTo: Add an image.
Move your cursor over the image — a magnifier helps you aim.
Click to pick a color.
Copy the HEX, RGB or HSL value, and see your color history.

faqs.a: It reads the exact pixel under your cursor using the Canvas API — 100% accurate, down to a single pixel.
HEX, RGB and HSL. Click any of them to copy it.

faqs.q: Can I pick from transparent areas?
faqs.a: Transparent pixels report their RGB value with full alpha, shown as the pixel color.

color-palette-extractor.name: Color Palette Extractor
color-palette-extractor.short: Extract dominant colors from an image.
color-palette-extractor.description: Extract the dominant color palette from any JPG, PNG or WebP image online. Generate 5–10 swatches with HEX and RGB — free.
color-palette-extractor.intro: Turn any photo into a designer-ready color palette. Our median-cut algorithm finds the most dominant colors in your image and presents them as clean swatches you can copy or export.
howTo: Add an image.
Choose how many colors to extract.
Press Extract colors.
Copy any swatch's HEX code or export the full palette.

faqs.a: A median-cut quantization algorithm groups the most frequently occurring colors in the image and returns the dominant representatives.

faqs.q: How many colors can I extract?
faqs.a: 5, 8 or 10 — you choose.
Yes — as a PNG swatch card or as a JSON file with all the HEX and RGB values.

image-to-grayscale.name: Image to Grayscale
image-to-grayscale.short: Convert images to black and white.
image-to-grayscale.description: Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images to grayscale online for free. Beautiful black-and-white conversion right in your browser.
image-to-grayscale.intro: Transform color images into classic black and white. Piclizer uses perceptual luminance weighting, so your grayscale images look natural — not flat.
howTo: Add an image.
Press Convert to grayscale.
Preview the black-and-white result.
Download your image in the original or PNG format.

faqs.a: Each pixel's red, green and blue channels are combined using perceptual weights that match human vision, producing natural-looking results.
Yes, for PNG images the alpha channel is kept intact.
The original format or PNG, your choice.

image-watermark.name: Image Watermark
image-watermark.short: Add text or logo watermarks to images.
image-watermark.description: Add text or image watermarks to JPG, PNG and WebP images online. 9 positions, tiling, opacity and font controls — free and private.
image-watermark.intro: Protect your images with a custom watermark. Add styled text or your own logo, position it anywhere across a 9-point grid, tile it for full coverage, and control size and opacity.
howTo: Add the image you want to watermark.
Choose a text or image watermark.
Set the text, font, size, color, opacity and position.
Press Apply watermark and download the result.

faqs.q: Can I use my own logo as a watermark?
faqs.a: Yes — upload a PNG or JPG logo and control its size, opacity and position.
Tiling repeats the watermark across the entire image, which makes it much harder to remove.
JPG, PNG and WebP, with the output in the same format.

pdf-merger.name: PDF Merger
pdf-merger.short: Combine several PDF files into one document.
pdf-merger.description: Merge PDF files online for free. Combine multiple documents into one, reorder them by dragging, and download instantly — everything runs in your browser.
pdf-merger.intro: Bring several PDFs together into a single, tidy document. Drag the files into the order you want, merge them in one click, and keep every page exactly as it was — no uploads, no watermarks, no page limits.
howTo: Add two or more PDF files with drag & drop or the browse button.
Drag the file cards to arrange them in the order you want.
Press Merge PDFs and wait for the progress bar to finish.
Download the combined document to your device.

faqs.q: Are my PDF files uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Merging happens entirely inside your browser using pdf-lib. Your documents never leave your device, which is why the tool also works offline once the page is loaded.

faqs.q: How many PDFs can I merge at once?
faqs.a: Up to 20 files, each up to 50 MB, with a combined limit of 200 MB. These limits keep the merge comfortably within your browser's available memory.

faqs.q: Will merging change the quality of my pages?
faqs.a: No. Pages are copied as-is, so text stays selectable, images keep their original resolution and vector graphics remain sharp.
Not directly. Remove the password first with our PDF Unlock tool, then merge the unprotected files.

pdf-splitter.name: PDF Splitter
pdf-splitter.short: Split one PDF into several separate files.
pdf-splitter.description: Split a PDF online for free. Extract every page separately, cut into fixed chunks, or define custom page ranges — processed privately in your browser.
pdf-splitter.intro: Break a long PDF into smaller documents in the way that suits you: one file per page, fixed groups of pages, or your own custom ranges. Results are packaged so you can download everything at once.
howTo: Select the PDF you want to split.
Choose a split mode: one file per page, every N pages, or custom ranges.
Enter your ranges, for example 1-3, 5, 8-10.
Press Split PDF and download the files individually or as a ZIP.

faqs.q: How do I write a page range?
faqs.a: Use commas to separate parts and dashes for ranges — 1-3, 5, 8-10 produces three files covering pages 1 to 3, page 5, and pages 8 to 10.
Never. The file on your device is only read; every split part is created as a brand-new document in memory.
Files up to 100 MB and 500 pages. Larger documents may still work but can be slow depending on your device.

faqs.q: Can I download all parts together?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Download all to receive a ZIP archive that is also built locally in your browser.
No. Pages are copied without re-encoding, so fonts, images and vectors are identical to the original.

pdf-delete-pages.name: Delete PDF Pages
pdf-delete-pages.short: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF.
pdf-delete-pages.description: Delete pages from a PDF online for free. Click page thumbnails to remove them and save a clean document — private, in-browser processing with no uploads.
pdf-delete-pages.intro: Get rid of blank sheets, cover pages or anything you no longer need. Preview every page as a thumbnail, mark what to remove, and save a clean copy of your document.
howTo: Open your PDF in the tool.
Wait for the page thumbnails to render.
Click the pages you want to delete, or type a range instead.
Press Delete selected pages and download the result.

faqs.a: Yes. Selections are only applied when you press the delete button, and your original file is never changed, so you can always start over.
No — a PDF must keep at least one page, so the tool blocks a selection that would empty the document.

faqs.q: Why do thumbnails take a moment to appear?
faqs.a: Each page is rendered locally with pdf.js. Large or graphics-heavy documents simply take longer to draw.

faqs.q: Is anything uploaded while I preview pages?
faqs.a: No. Rendering and editing both run on your device; no page image or file byte is ever transmitted.

faqs.q: Does the file get smaller after deleting pages?
faqs.a: Usually yes, though shared resources such as embedded fonts may still be kept, so the reduction is not always proportional.

pdf-reorder-pages.name: Reorder PDF Pages
pdf-reorder-pages.short: Rearrange the page order of a PDF.
pdf-reorder-pages.description: Reorder PDF pages online for free. Drag page thumbnails into a new order and save the rearranged document — fully private, in-browser processing.
pdf-reorder-pages.intro: Put your pages in the right order by dragging their thumbnails around. Ideal for fixing scans that came out backwards or moving an appendix to the end.
howTo: Choose the PDF you want to rearrange.
Drag the page thumbnails into the order you prefer.
Use Reset order at any time to start again.
Press Apply new order and download the document.

faqs.q: How many pages can I reorder?
faqs.a: Up to 200 pages. Beyond that, thumbnail rendering becomes heavy for most browsers.

about.title: About Piclizer
about.p1: Piclizer is a free collection of image tools that run entirely in your web browser. There are no servers processing your images, no uploads, and no accounts — just fast, private tools you can use the moment the page loads.
about.p2: Our mission is simple: make everyday image tasks free, instant and private for everyone. Compressing a photo for an email, resizing a banner for a website, or converting a logo to the right format should never require installing software or trusting a stranger with your files.
about.p3: We achieve this with modern browser technology. The Canvas, Blob and File APIs — the same building blocks used by professional web-based editors — let us process images entirely on your device, inside your own browser tab.
about.p4: Piclizer is honest about what it is: a small, independent tool set built for privacy-first workflows. We don't have fake user counts or invented testimonials. If a tool works for you, that's our success metric.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Piclizer collects and how it is used. The short version: we collect almost nothing, and your images never leave your device.
privacy.p1: Piclizer does not require an account and does not collect names, emails or personal information. We do not receive, store or process your images — all processing happens locally in your browser.
privacy.p2: Like most websites, our hosting provider may keep standard technical logs (such as IP address and user agent) needed to operate and secure the service. We do not use these logs to identify individuals.
privacy.p2b: We use a small first-party cookie to remember your consent preferences, plus your language and theme choices. With your consent we may enable analytics or advertising cookies, which are off by default. See our Cookie Policy for details.
privacy.p3: When you consent, we may load analytics (e.g. Google Analytics) or advertising (e.g. Google AdSense) scripts. These services have their own privacy policies and operate only with your permission.
privacy.p4: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time via the Cookie Settings link in the footer. Because we hold no personal data about you, there is typically nothing to access, correct or delete — but you can contact us anytime.
privacy.p5: For privacy inquiries, use the contact page or email privacy@piclizer.app.

terms.intro: By using Piclizer you agree to these terms. They're written in plain language.
terms.p1: You may use Piclizer for any lawful purpose. You are responsible for the images you process and must have the rights to use them.
terms.p2: Do not use Piclizer to process illegal content, content that infringes others' rights, or content that is harmful, deceptive or abusive. Automated abuse or attempts to disrupt the service are prohibited.
terms.p3: Piclizer is provided 'as is' and 'as available', without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that tools are error-free or that outputs will meet your requirements.
terms.p4: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Piclizer is not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.
terms.p5: We may update these terms occasionally. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated terms.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This policy explains what cookies are, which ones Piclizer uses, and how you can control them.
cookiePolicy.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. They help websites remember preferences and understand usage.
cookiePolicy.p2: Necessary: required for basic function (consent state, session). Functional: your language and theme preferences. Analytics: usage statistics, off by default. Advertising: ad personalization, off by default.
cookiePolicy.p3: You can change your choices at any time using the Cookie Settings link in the footer, or by clearing cookies in your browser settings.
cookiePolicy.p4: Analytics and advertising cookies load only after you give explicit consent. Necessary cookies do not require consent.
